To add our own footnote to this report, our thanks are due to all those who helped to make the race a success, to those who gave so generously to the prize fund, to Arthur Whitehead for providing accommodation and refreshments for our own walkers and to the Lic…
Team Championship.—3rd Cadogan A.C., 45 points. Readman, 5; Rutland, 10; Oliver, 14; Bentley, 16.

Here we must mention George Oliver who walked the same steady race as in the " Garnett " Cup 10 miles. Unfortunately our hopes were dashed when we learnt that Dave McMullen who had walked splendidly up to then had been ruled out at 8½ miles.
All our lads started fairly steady and at three miles Charlie Churcher and Bob McMullen were in 5th and 6th positions, whilst Bob Readman and George Oliver were together at 15th.

…, with Bob McMullen, walking his first 20, some 40 yards further back, followed by Messrs. Wright, Bidgood, Bentley and Oliver. It is interesting to note that Jack Rutland, who finished 4th, was at this stage 12th.…
At the start, Allen got away very fast with Bert Clayton close on his heels and the rest of our boys well up filling various positions from George Oliver 15 to Tony Bellchamber 60.
Scratch Team : 3, Belgrave (James, Jarlett, Oliver, Waddingham). Handicap Team : 3, Belgrave (Jarlett, Smith, James, Oliver).
SIX MILES: Belgrave's ARTHUR PENNY (7) won from Rankine (Canada), Furze (5), Holden(6), Potts (8) and Oliver (Canada) in 31:00.

The combination of these two plus Gleeson and Oliver was far too strong for any other team the South of England could put up. They recorded the same time in the heat and final,winning by a full ten yards - an excellent performance.
